alate: Head and body brown, the head deeper, antennae, postclypeus and the parts below the femora brownish yellow, wings pale brown. Head oval; compound eyes circular, ocelli elliptical, the ocellus-compound eye distance less than the transverse diameter of the ocellus, or the two almost touching; postclypeus less than half as long as wide, raised very high, its anterior margin straight, the posterior margin strongly arched. In individuals with 16 antennal segments the third, fourth and fifth are all shorter than the second. Pronotum ingot-shaped, narrower than the head, with a pale T-shaped mark in the middle, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the middle of the posterior margin deeply concave. Wings about twice as long as the body, the forewing scale almost reaching the base of the hindwing scale; the radius sector of the forewing runs close to the anterior margin straight to the wing tip without distinct branches, the media arises independently at the humeral suture, its distance from the cubitus nearer than that from the radius sector, and divides at the end into several branches reaching the wing tip, the cubitus with about ten branches; the media of the hindwing arises from the radius sector behind the humeral suture. The wing surface is smooth, with only sparse short hairs.
distribution: Jinghong (500 m) and Menghai (1180 m), Yunnan; abroad recorded from Myanmar.
soldier: Head and labrum pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown, antennae milky white, pronotum, abdomen and legs nearly milky white. Head densely covered with fine short hairs, the labrum with apical hairs and with long and short hairs intermixed. Head elongate-oval, narrow in front and broad behind, in profile the middle of the vertex raised like a mound; labrum mostly spear-shaped; the middle of the left mandible slightly arched, with a minute tooth before the basal tooth; the right mandible slightly thinner than the left; the postmentum widest at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments. The middle of both the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum is concave inwards.
